name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the user explicitly requests the next APK update.
notes: Phase 345 adds one shared player account client for the website, Android, Quest, and PC routes.
Authenticated game routes create activity sessions and send one heartbeat per minute while the game is visible.
The secure backend contract supports registration, login, HTTP-only sessions, profile records, game sessions, and transactional daily rewards.
The default daily reward is 5,000 play-money chips after 300 verified active seconds and at least three accepted heartbeats.
Local demo mode is explicitly labeled and never claims to populate the production database.
The Android Phase 343 HUD, Phase 344 input lock, and Phase 342 performance governor remain preserved.
APK update prompts remain disabled and installation remains manual-only.
